detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=oci`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure with the modular input for `oci:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.7.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `eventName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=oci sourcetype=oci:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:audit" eventName="com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.CreateBucket"
| table _time eventName identity.principalName resourceId
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.7.10_oci_audit_createbucket_10"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `oci:audit` in `index=oci` to detect oci audit createbucket. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the OCI Console Audit page for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `eventName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_7_10_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of oci audit createbucket so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
